Bombay High Court Bans Firecrackers on Mumbai Roads, Cites Pollution

The Bombay High Court has banned the bursting of firecrackers on public roads in Mumbai, citing air pollution concerns. The court also directed civic and police authorities to develop an action plan to enforce the ban. This action follows ongoing issues with air quality in the city.
